capture.text:
# Quality Technician - Middleton
**Dwyer Instruments, Inc.**
Middleton, WI 53562, United States Full Time
Reference: Dwyer Instruments, Inc._4542467
Job Type
Full-time
Description
Job responsibilities as follows:
* Incoming Inspections
* Processes First-Article & Incoming Inspections
* Logs records of inspection
* Monitors list of flagged parts requiring inspection
* RMAs
* Issuing and resolving RMAs, as needed
* Reporting on trends
* Control of Non-Conforming Material
* Logs and records nonconforming material transactions
* Works with Vendors to return product
* Reviews vendor performance and reports on trends
* Issues SCARs and follows up with Vendors for completion.
* Fixed Asset Program
* Calibration
* Managing the Calibration Schedule
* Ensuring assets are calibrated at set intervals
* Working with companies to setup calibration jobs (On site or offsite)
* Preventative Maintenance
* Managing the PM Schedule
* Ensuring tasks are done on time
* Manages the Electrostatic Discharge Program
* Updates equipment (as needed)
* Tests and verifies that equipment is functional
* Trains employees on the importance of ESD practices
* Vendor Evaluation/Reporting
* Work with Purchasing to provide vendor feedback on Nonconforming Material and/or reporting Vendor DPPM
* Report, as requested, to Management on Quality and any other outstanding issues
* Assist with the following processes:
* Conduct Internal Audits (Leading & Participation) and address findings where necessary
* Control of Documents; Updating & revising QMS Documentation
* Corrective Actions: Issuing, Root Cause Analysis, and Closure
* Participate and represent Quality in the CCB (Change Control Board) ECR/ECO discussions. Follow through with any Quality related tasks for closure.
* Perform data analysis related to Quality Metrics and Objectives, as needed
* Other duties as assigned.
Requirements
Physical Aspects of the Job:
* Must be able to sit for extended periods of time.
* Ability to look at a computer screen for extended periods of time.
* Some lifting required (up to 60lbs).
* Some travel required.
Qualifications:
* Able to work independently on projects and collaborate as a strong team member.
* Communicate effectively both internally and externally.
* Strong leadership and team building skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, flexible and adaptable to change.
* Strong ability to multitask and meet project deadlines.
* Excellent computer skills (MS Office Required).
* Ability to make sound business decisions
Skills
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Experienced in Microsoft Office.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
Work experience & Education
* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Electronics, or Operations related field preferred; Associate's degree preferred, but not required.
* Work experience of 1 -3 years in an ISO certified manufacturing facility preferred.
